product_one_liner.value: Harmony Healthcare IT’s HealthData Platform securely archives patient, employee and business records and enables their release and sharing for healthcare providers.

pricing_page.notes: The public page describes standard, enterprise and SaaS pricing models, although it does not publish numerical prices.

employee_band.notes: The reported LinkedIn employee count of 235 falls within this band.

eng_blog.notes: The indexes show migration guidance, data-management advice and customer articles, not two engineer-authored posts about building the product.

public_docs.notes: Public product-use documentation includes Conversions, DR Dashboard, DR Auditor and OpenGate tutorials.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: None of the six listed openings has a qualifying AI, ML or data-science title.

model_provider.notes: No specific model or provider was disclosed in the reviewed product materials, tutorials, blog, security FAQ, Trust Center or privacy disclosures. ClearWay mentions AI and NLP without naming a provider; Harmony Ignite supplies datasets for AI development.

compliance_certs.notes: These are publicly listed Trust Center claims; this does not independently verify their scope.

last_funding.notes: Novacap investment announced November 28, 2023; the amount was not publicly disclosed.

raised_18mo.notes: The latest identified round, November 28, 2023, predates the requested 18-month window.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The six openings include Business Development Director and Associate Business Development Director, but no qualifying SDR, BDR or account-executive title.

launched_6mo.notes: No qualifying dated launch was found for May 9–November 9, 2026. The newest dated product launch located was ClearWay on February 25, 2025; Harmony Ignite’s pages do not state a launch date.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: Brian Liddell was appointed CEO effective April 30, 2026; Matt Cook’s CTO appointment was announced March 24, 2026.

crm_stack_signal.notes: The sales posting describes Sugar CRM and Definitive Healthcare usage; the privacy policy explicitly names Act-On. Salesforce appears only as an alternative preferred experience, so it is excluded.
